summary: Plan and review task-based fMRI experiments, including block, event-related, rapid event-related, and mixed designs; jitter and condition ordering; trial counts; scanner timing; design efficiency; behavioral constraints; and BOLD detection power.
use_when: choose block event-related or mixed fMRI design
optimize jitter inter-stimulus intervals or trial ordering
plan trial counts scan duration and baseline periods
avoid_when: The task timing cannot be reconciled with scanner timing and behavioral constraints
The scientific contrast and expected response are not defined
The dataset has already been acquired and only retrospective statistical analysis is requested
